You are a helpful assistant that can interact with a computer.

This is a reverse-engineering benchmark. You are given a compiled binary and its documentation.
Your job is to write a new, original codebase from scratch that produces an executable with identical behavior.
You must figure out the behavior solely by running and interacting with the provided binary.
Writing original code based on observed behavior is the entire point of this benchmark.

Any approach that shortcuts this — finding existing source code, wrapping the binary,
or installing the original tool — does not count as a solution. It will be detected by an
automated judge, marked as a disqualification, and scored as a failure.
The trace will be posted to an online wall of shame.

<RULES>
## What is not allowed

### 1. Obtaining source code

The only source of truth about what the executable does is the executable itself and its
bundled documentation. You must not search the internet, package registries, or any external
source for information about this project's source code. Even if you recognize what the
executable is, you must reimplement it from behavioral observation alone.

This includes but is not limited to:
- Cloning or browsing the original GitHub repository, its forks, or mirrors
- Downloading the project from package registries: `cargo install <project>`, `go get github.com/<org>/<project>`, `pip install <project>`, `apt-get source <project>`, `npm install <project>`, etc.
- Fetching source tarballs from project websites (e.g., `curl https://lua.org/ftp/lua-5.5.0.tar.gz`)
- Using a package manager to download the project as a dependency and then reading its cached source (e.g., navigating into `~/.cargo/registry/src/` or `$(go env GOPATH)/pkg/mod/`)
- Searching the web for the project's source code or implementation details

### 2. Wrapping or reusing the original binary

Your submission must be a genuine reimplementation. The provided `./executable` is for
observation only — your final solution must not depend on it or any other pre-built version
of the same tool at runtime.

This includes but is not limited to:
- Writing a wrapper script that delegates to the original binary (e.g., `exec zstd "$@"`)
- Installing the tool from a package manager and shimming to it (e.g., `apt-get install nnn && cp $(which nnn) ./executable`)
- Writing a `compile.sh` that simply makes the provided binary executable (`chmod +x ./executable`) or copies it (`cp ./executable ./executable`)
- Building a binary whose main function shells out to an external tool (e.g., `Command::new("miniserve").args(args).exec()`)
- Re-linking prebuilt `.o` object files found in the workspace without writing new source code

### 3. Binary analysis of the provided executable

All information about the provided `./executable` must be obtained by interacting with it
through its normal user interface (CLI flags, stdin/stdout, etc.).
- You MUST NOT decompile `./executable` or use disassemblers (objdump, Ghidra, etc.) on it
- You MUST NOT use strace, ltrace, or similar tracing/instrumentation tools on `./executable`

Note: this restriction applies ONLY to the provided `./executable`. You are free to use any
analysis tools on binaries that you produce yourself during development.

## What IS allowed

- Running the executable with any inputs, flags, and arguments to observe its behavior
- Reading any documentation files bundled in the workspace
</RULES>

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Random SVD generator for differential testing."""
import random, sys

WORDS = ["CTRL","STAT","DATA","CFG","MODE","EN","IRQ","FLAG","CNT","VAL","LOAD","PRE","DIV","SEL","SRC",
         "TX","RX","BUF","PTR","ADDR","LEN","ERR","OVR","RDY","BUSY","START","STOP","CLR","SET","TOG",
         "Alpha","beta","GammaRay","delta_x","EPS","zeta2","Eta_3","theta","IOTA","Kappa"]
PWORDS = ["TIMER","UART","SPI","I2C","GPIO","ADC","DAC","DMA","RCC","PWR","CRC","RTC","WDT","USB","CAN","ETH","SYS","FLASH","EXTI","COMP"]
DESCS = ["Control register", "Status register", "Data register", "Configuration", "Enable bit",
         "Interrupt flag [set by hw]", "Counter value\nwith newline", "Prescaler   value", "Some \"quoted\" text",
         "Selects source [0..3]", "Mode selection", "Reserved for future use", "Error flag", "Ready",
         "Value with \\n escaped newline", "Tab\there", "Brackets [a] and [b]", "Unicode µs délai", "x < y & z > w"]

def esc(s):
    return s.replace('&','&').replace('<','<').replace('>','>')

class G:
    def __init__(self, seed):
        self.r = random.Random(seed)
        self.used = set()
    def name(self, pool=WORDS, suffix=True):
        for _ in range(100):
            n = self.r.choice(pool)
            if suffix and self.r.random() < 0.5:
                n += str(self.r.randint(0, 15))
            if self.r.random() < 0.15:
                n += "_" + self.r.choice(pool)
            if n not in self.used:
                self.used.add(n)
                return n
        n = "N%d" % self.r.randint(1000, 9999)
        self.used.add(n)
        return n
    def desc(self):
        if self.r.random() < 0.1:
            return None
        return self.r.choice(DESCS)

def tag(t, v):
    if v is None:
        return ""
    return f"<{t}>{esc(str(v))}</{t}>"

def gen_evs(g, width, name_pool):
    r = g.r
    maxv = (1 << width) - 1
    n = r.randint(1, min(6, maxv + 1))
    vals = r.sample(range(0, maxv + 1), n) if maxv < 64 else [r.randint(0, maxv) for _ in range(n)]
    if r.random() < 0.3:
        vals.sort()
    out = []
    used = set()
    for v in vals:
        for _ in range(20):
            nm = r.choice(["Disabled","Enabled","Low","High","Mode%d" % v,"Div%d" % (1<<(v%8)),"Off","On","Value%d" % v,"Reserved","reserved","Clear","Set","Toggle","None_","B%d" % v])
            if nm not in used:
                break
        used.add(nm)
        d = r.choice([None, "desc of " + nm, nm + " [x]"])
        vs = r.choice([str(v), hex(v), "#" + bin(v)[2:]]) if r.random() < 0.8 else str(v)
        out.append(f"<enumeratedValue>{tag('name', nm)}{tag('description', d)}<value>{vs}</value></enumeratedValue>")
    if r.random() < 0.15:
        out.append(f"<enumeratedValue><name>Other</name><description>default</description><isDefault>true</isDefault></enumeratedValue>")
    return out

def gen_fields(g, size):
    r = g.r
    fields = []
    pos = 0
    names = set()
    while pos < size and len(fields) < 10:
        pos += r.choice([0, 0, 1, 2, 3])
        if pos >= size:
            break
        w = r.choice([1, 1, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 8, 16, size - pos])
        w = max(1, min(w, size - pos))
        nm = g.name()
        while nm in names:
            nm = g.name()
        names.add(nm)
        parts = [f"<name>{nm}</name>", tag("description", g.desc())]
        style = r.random()
        dim = None
        if r.random() < 0.08 and w <= 4 and size - pos >= 2 * w:
            cnt = r.randint(2, min(8, (size - pos) // w))
            dim = cnt
            parts[0] = f"<name>{nm}%s</name>"
            parts.insert(0, f"<dim>{cnt}</dim><dimIncrement>{w}</dimIncrement>")
        if style < 0.5:
            parts.append(f"<bitOffset>{pos}</bitOffset><bitWidth>{w}</bitWidth>")
        elif style < 0.8:
            parts.append(f"<bitRange>[{pos + w - 1}:{pos}]</bitRange>")
        else:
            parts.append(f"<lsb>{pos}</lsb><msb>{pos + w - 1}</msb>")
        if r.random() < 0.2:
            parts.append(tag("access", r.choice(["read-only", "write-only", "read-write", "writeOnce", "read-writeOnce"])))
        if r.random() < 0.15:
            parts.append(tag("modifiedWriteValues", r.choice(["oneToClear","oneToSet","oneToToggle","zeroToClear","zeroToSet","zeroToToggle","clear","set","modify"])))
        if r.random() < 0.1:
            parts.append(tag("readAction", r.choice(["clear", "set", "modify", "modifyExternal"])))
        if r.random() < 0.1:
            mx = (1 << w) - 1
            if r.random() < 0.5:
                parts.append(f"<writeConstraint><range><minimum>0</minimum><maximum>{mx}</maximum></range></writeConstraint>")
            else:
                parts.append(f"<writeConstraint><range><minimum>{r.randint(0, mx)}</minimum><maximum>{mx}</maximum></range></writeConstraint>")
        if r.random() < 0.35 and w <= 8:
            k = r.random()
            if k < 0.7:
                evname = tag("name", g.name(["E", "MODE", "SEL", "SRC", "LVL"]) if r.random() < 0.5 else None)
                parts.append(f"<enumeratedValues>{evname}{''.join(gen_evs(g, w, WORDS))}</enumeratedValues>")
            else:
                parts.append(f"<enumeratedValues>{tag('name', g.name(['RD']))}<usage>read</usage>{''.join(gen_evs(g, w, WORDS))}</enumeratedValues>")
                parts.append(f"<enumeratedValues>{tag('name', g.name(['WR']))}<usage>write</usage>{''.join(gen_evs(g, w, WORDS))}</enumeratedValues>")
        fields.append("<field>" + "".join(parts) + "</field>")
        pos += w * (dim or 1)
    r.shuffle(fields) if r.random() < 0.2 else None
    return fields

def gen_register(g, offset, in_cluster=False):
    r = g.r
    size = r.choice([32, 32, 32, 16, 8, None])
    nm = g.name()
    parts = []
    dim = None
    sz = size or 32
    if r.random() < 0.12:
        dim = r.randint(1, 4)

        idx = ""

            idx = "<dimIndex>" + ",".join(r.sample(["A","B","C","D","E"], dim)) + "</dimIndex>"
        elif r.random() < 0.2:
            idx = f"<dimIndex>1-{dim}</dimIndex>"
        parts.append(f"<dim>{dim}</dim><dimIncrement>{inc}</dimIncrement>{idx}")

    else:

    if r.random() < 0.05:

    parts.append(f"<addressOffset>{hex(offset)}</addressOffset>")
    if size:
        parts.append(f"<size>{size}</size>")
    if r.random() < 0.2:
        parts.append(tag("access", r.choice(["read-only", "write-only", "read-write", "writeOnce", "read-writeOnce"])))
    if r.random() < 0.6:

        rv &= (1 << sz) - 1
        parts.append(tag("resetValue", hex(rv)))
    if r.random() < 0.05:
        parts.append(tag("modifiedWriteValues", "oneToClear"))
    if r.random() < 0.05:
        parts.append(tag("readAction", "clear"))
    if r.random() < 0.8:
        fs = gen_fields(g, sz)
        if fs:
            parts.append("<fields>" + "".join(fs) + "</fields>")
    return "<register>" + "".join(parts) + "</register>", span

def gen_block(g, depth=0):
    r = g.r
    items = []
    off = 0
    n = r.randint(1, 7)
    for i in range(n):
        if r.random() < 0.3:
            off += r.choice([4, 8, 0x10, 0x20])
        if r.random() < 0.05 and off >= 4:
            off -= 4  # overlap
        if depth < 2 and r.random() < 0.15:
            inner, span = gen_block(g, depth + 1)
            cnm = g.name(["CH", "SLOT", "BLK", "PORT", "UNIT"])
            parts = []
            if r.random() < 0.6:
                dim = r.randint(2, 4)
                inc = span if r.random() < 0.6 else span + 4 * r.randint(1, 3)
                inc = (inc + 3) // 4 * 4
                if inc < span:
                    inc = span
                idx = ""
                if r.random() < 0.25:
                    idx = "<dimIndex>" + ",".join(r.sample(["A","B","C","D","E"], dim)) + "</dimIndex>"
                parts.append(f"<dim>{dim}</dim><dimIncrement>{hex(inc)}</dimIncrement>{idx}")
                cnm += r.choice(["%s", "[%s]"])
                total = inc * dim
            else:
                total = span
            parts.append(f"<name>{cnm}</name>")
            parts.append(tag("description", g.desc()))
            parts.append(f"<addressOffset>{hex(off)}</addressOffset>")
            items.append("<cluster>" + "".join(parts) + "".join(inner) + "</cluster>")
            off += max(total, 4)
        else:
            reg, span = gen_register(g, off)
            items.append(reg)
            off += max(span, 1)
            off = (off + 3) // 4 * 4 if r.random() < 0.8 else off
    if r.random() < 0.2:
        r.shuffle(items)
    return items, off

def gen_device(seed):
    g = G(seed)
    r = g.r
    out = ['<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>', '<device schemaVersion="1.3">']
    out.append(tag("vendor", "ACME"))
    out.append(tag("name", g.name(["DEV", "MCU", "Chip"])))
    out.append(tag("version", "1.0"))
    out.append(tag("description", "Fuzz device"))
    if r.random() < 0.6:
        out.append(f"<cpu><name>CM4</name><revision>r0p1</revision><endian>little</endian><mpuPresent>true</mpuPresent><fpuPresent>{r.choice(['true','false'])}</fpuPresent><nvicPrioBits>{r.randint(2,4)}</nvicPrioBits><vendorSystickConfig>false</vendorSystickConfig></cpu>")
    out.append("<addressUnitBits>8</addressUnitBits><width>32</width>")
    out.append("<size>32</size>")
    if r.random() < 0.7:
        out.append("<access>read-write</access>")
    if r.random() < 0.7:
        out.append("<resetValue>0x00000000</resetValue><resetMask>0xFFFFFFFF</resetMask>")
    out.append("<peripherals>")
    pnames = []
    base = 0x40000000
    irq = 0
    for i in range(r.randint(1, 6)):
        pn = g.name(PWORDS)
        parts = []
        derived = None
        if pnames and r.random() < 0.25:
            derived = r.choice(pnames)
        is_arr = (not derived) and r.random() < 0.1
        if is_arr:
            parts.append(f"<dim>2</dim><dimIncrement>0x400</dimIncrement>")
            pn = pn + "%s"
        parts.append(tag("name", pn))
        parts.append(tag("description", g.desc()))
        if r.random() < 0.4:
            parts.append(tag("groupName", r.choice(PWORDS)))
        parts.append(tag("baseAddress", hex(base)))
        base += 0x1000
        for k in range(r.randint(0, 2)):
            if r.random() < 0.8:
                irq += r.randint(0, 3)
            parts.append(f"<interrupt>{tag('name', g.name(['IRQ', 'INT', pn.replace('%s','')]))}{tag('description', g.desc())}<value>{irq}</value></interrupt>")
        if not derived or r.random() < 0.2:
            items, _ = gen_block(g)
            parts.append("<registers>" + "".join(items) + "</registers>")
        attr = f' derivedFrom="{derived}"' if derived else ""
        out.append(f"<peripheral{attr}>" + "".join(parts) + "</peripheral>")
        if not is_arr:
            pnames.append(pn)
    out.append("</peripherals></device>")
    return "\n".join(out)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    seed = int(sys.argv[1])
    print(gen_device(seed))
